task: Implement shared MossMap and MossSet kernel in the compiler-owned moss_runtime crate.
observation: Designing MossMap operations to take statically specialized hash and equality callables at call sites completely avoided dynamic trait objects (dyn), runtime closures, and per-process RandomState, while preserving deterministic bucket storage across crates.
impact: Separately compiled Rust provider and consumer crates link against the identical libmoss_runtime.rlib without type duplication or dynamic dispatch overhead, enabling zero-copy Map and Set sharing across package boundaries.

resolution.summary: Implemented and verified MossMap and MossSet static caller specialization across multi-crate linkage in Debug and Release profiles.
